mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 1.0%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever FEDFUNDS is at or below 1.0%.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS <= 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE <= 4.5%) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 1.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE <= 4.5%) signals a favorable monetary and labor market environment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and tight labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS <= 1.0% AND UNRATE <= 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.8% and rising for 3 months) compresses equity valuations due to higher discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 0.8% and rising for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above its 2017 base level (100) indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 thousand units indicate strong residential construction activity, supporting consumer confidence and corporate growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1200 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of strong housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and robust industrial production (INDPRO > 100) signals a synchronized expansion in residential construction and manufacturing, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1200 AND INDPRO > 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL < 245) indicates a stable price environment that supports corporate profit growth and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not significantly positive when CPIAUCSL < 245 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
